fusions.name: Along the Grain
fusions.desc: A placed blow that deals 14 damage, stuns the target for 1 second and leaves it 20% easier to wound for 6 seconds. It deals 8% more for each affliction already on the target, up to 40%.

fusions.name: Flawless Tremor
fusions.desc: You stamp once with drilled precision, dealing 28 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles. Every hit is a critical hit.

fusions.name: Rooted Focus
fusions.desc: You set your feet and hold still for 1.5 seconds, then your critical hit chance rises by 25% for 15 seconds.

fusions.name: Worn Grooves
fusions.desc: Every ability you have comes round 8% sooner, and you carry 10% physical resistance.
